blocks.text: Psalms 43 contains 5 verses. It opens with: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man. It concludes with: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him, `Who is' the help of my countenance, and my God. Psalm 44 For the Chief Musician. `A Psalm' of the sons of Korah. Maschil.
